release_notes: v9.8.32 (guid-bound) — Multi-Company Safety Layer #2: FLOWRA now anchors each tenant to Tally's INTERNAL $Guid (immutable per company file). On every cycle the agent fetches the GUID via an SVCurrentCompany-scoped Collection request and includes it in every sync payload. First successful sync auto-binds (Trust-On-First-Use); any subsequent cycle whose GUID doesn't match is HARD-BLOCKED at the FLOWRA server — sister-concern vouchers can no longer bleed into the wrong workspace even if the operator has multiple companies loaded and tabs mid-sync. Complements v9.8.31's ListOfCompanies preflight (name-based warning) with GUID enforcement (hard block). Useradmin can unbind from FLOWRA → Settings → Integrations. Also: 9 pre-existing lint-warnings cleaned up (bare-except → Exception, hashlib top-level import, USER_EMAIL resolved via auth_config, tk.after lambda `err=e` capture fix).
